The crocodile grows 8 inches in 4 years. To find the growth rate per year, we divide 8 inches by 4 years:  
8 inches ÷ 4 years = 2 inches per year.  

To find how many inches it will grow in 13 years, we multiply the growth rate by 13:  
2 inches/year × 13 years = 26 inches.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 26
